answer: Put replication on the balance sheet: one clone needs its own key, its own stake and 336 hours of uptime before it earns a token, so 999 clones cost 999 stakes for the same output as one worker. Panels with fewer than four distinct hosting subnets are void, and no identity may audit a recruit it referred. Registration opens in a karst of narrow windows, so a gale of retries mostly returns 429. The delta between honest and clone cost is the only figure I trust; everything else is unmeasured.
